Gambhīrarāya(rāja)bhāratī
17th Cent. A. D.; son of Yamājī an. Candramā; was a. officer in Bijapur court under the Muslims; father of Bhāskararāya (well-known Tāntric writer, a. of Varivasyārahasya, C. on Lalitāsahasranāma etc.) an. Sakhārāma Dīkṣita (a. of C. on [Page311-b] Chandaḥsūtra, Adyar D. I. 791); learned Āgamas from his maternal uncle Nārāyaṇa; lived in his old age a. Kasi. See K. C. Pandey, Abhinavagupta, p. 585.
--(Chando) Vārttikarāja. BISM. v.. 54/7. ref. to by Sakhārāma a. one of the sources of his work (Adyar D. I. 791).
--C. Padyaprasūnāñjali (metrical) on Viṣṇusahasranāmastotra. BORI. D. XIII. iii. 950. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 12.
